description: A show where women dancers portray their talent, strength and passion as they team up with the male celebrities and give wings to their dreams to win the title.
Hiphop Aadhi joins the fans who enjoy folk songs as well as film music.
Pushpa poisons Kani's mind against Maaran and Veera. Kani stops Maaran from entering the house.
Ramachandran decides to marry Malar off to Maaran, while Maaran learns about Pushpa's plan.
Veera and Kanmani lose their brother in a road accident caused by Maaran. What happens when a series of unfortunate events lead Veera to marry Maaran, and Kanmani decides to seek revenge?
